{{Conjecture}}
A '''dog''' was owned by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] at some point prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle of Yavin]]. At a time when everything was [[Color/Legends|blue]] outside, Lando cried while reminiscing about his [[Dog/Legends|dog]], who had been run over by a [[hovercraft]].<ref name="Flamewind">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lando Calrissian&#39;s dog was first mentioned in the [[1983]] novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''.<ref name="Flamewind" />
